admit site vm of f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01 as paisans-f2a9 on fake (ubuntu 24.04)

step 1: start paisans-f2a9's manager after the mesh
  user: order user@1001.service after wg-quick@psns-f2a9 at boot, so a container that publishes on the mesh address finds it; a manager running now is not restarted, and takes it at its next start
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@1001.service.d/paisans-mesh.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans host admit for deployment f2a9; paisans host evict
    | # removes it. The user's manager, its Docker daemon and its containers
    | # start after the mesh at boot.
    | [Unit]
    | Wants=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
    | After=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

step 2: delegate cgroups to users
  delegation: let every user's manager delegate cpu cpuset io memory pids, for compose's limits; paisans-f2a9's manager is running, and takes it at its next start
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans host admit. Shared by every admitted deployment;
    | # paisans host evict removes it with the last of them.
    | [Service]
    | Delegate=cpu cpuset io memory pids
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

present: user: paisans-f2a9 exists, uid 1001, in no privileged group
present: user: paisans-f2a9 holds 165536-231071 in /etc/subuid
present: user: paisans-f2a9 holds 165536-231071 in /etc/subgid
present: linger: on for paisans-f2a9
present: linger: paisans-f2a9's manager is running
warning: delegation reaches paisans-f2a9's manager at its next start
  Its manager is running, and restarting it would restart its Docker daemon and every container in it, so admit does not. cpuset and io limits apply after the host's next reboot.
